title: 1.1.1.1 unreachable worldwide for 62 minutes
summary: A configuration error introduced weeks earlier tied the resolver's prefixes to a new service topology. A later change triggered a global routing refresh that withdrew 1.1.1.1 prefixes from the Internet.
cause: Internal configuration error (not an attack or BGP hijack)

title: BGP hijack and route leak of 1.1.1.1
summary: AS267613 originated 1.1.1.1/32 and a separate leak spread 1.1.1.0/24. Networks that do not enforce RPKI route-origin validation followed the bogus routes, so some users could not reach the resolver.
cause: External BGP hijack and route leak; RPKI ROV adoption limited the blast radius

title: SERVFAIL for some lookups after root-zone ZONEMD change
summary: Resolver software could not parse the root zone's new ZONEMD record. Part of the fleet served a stale root zone whose signatures expired, and DNSSEC validation failed for some queries.
cause: Software bug handling a new root zone record type

title: quad9.net names failed to resolve for up to ~40 minutes
summary: Undocumented zone-transfer dependencies broke during maintenance. Resolution through 9.9.9.9 kept working, but new DoH/DoT clients that needed to resolve dns.quad9.net could not connect.
cause: Maintenance change broke legacy zone imports

title: .de DNSSEC signing failure broke validation for ~3 hours
summary: A defect in DENIC's key-rollover software published bad .de signatures. Validating resolvers (Google, Cloudflare and most others) returned SERVFAIL for .de names until operators added overrides or DENIC fixed the zone.

title: Spike in user reports of Google Public DNS problems
summary: Downdetector recorded a surge of user reports. Google published no incident or root cause.

title: DoH over HTTP/1.1 discontinued
summary: Quad9 stopped serving DNS-over-HTTPS over HTTP/1.1. Older clients, including some routers, must use HTTP/2 or DoT.
